question: In a certain code language, if CHOSEN is coded as BGNNES, CLIENT is coded as BKHTNE, then what will DEALER be coded as?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/faa05794c535d8e3847a5c4e36c56250adadd16270c20615e138f6b6d410bf57.png] 

The logic followed here is:

CHOSEN is coded as BGNNES,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c1e4d0a5655c8c2b636bf9bc0b467065770f39cfb86a41caef5033d61840822.png] 

CLIENT is coded as BKHTNE,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/117249329857eee1f605d3766fcda4acaf2737d372dea04c02efb157ff564ceb.png] 

Similarly, DEALER will be

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d8c8b84d01b18c689d28df71a7bf67a4db02b94f451834fcad9ca3054f08dc.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"CDZREL".**
